comparators.label: Existing R2 (Belg) regime rule: R2 membership, FMAM >= 80 mm, patches < 3 cells removed
comparators.reference_note: Regime membership is not an amount/share threshold, so EMI classes imply no membership for it.

comparators.label: 40% contribution rule: FMAM >= 40% of annual and >= 80 mm (no cleanup)
Wettest-season rule: FMAM wetter than JJAS and ONDJ, >= 80 mm (no cleanup)
comparators.reference_note: Wettest-season membership compares FMAM with JJAS and ONDJ; the EMI maps give no JJAS/ONDJ amounts.

comparators.label: Previous FMAM site view (FMAM_belg_emi_domain, used until 2026-10-10): >= 20% and >= 100 mm from the 365-day cycle, patches < 3 cells removed

selection_rationale: Adopted 2026-10-10 as the broad FMAM working domain for Ethiopia: cells where FMAM contributes both a substantial amount (>= 100 mm) and a substantial share (>= 20%) of annual rainfall, i.e. a broad rainfall-contribution domain. The two cutoffs also coincide with EMI legend class breaks (101-200 mm; 21-30 %), which makes a visual comparison with EMI maps 2(e)/3(e) convenient; that comparison is visual and unreviewed and does not independently validate the thresholds. Stable against the 1996-2025 baseline. The included share of Ethiopia describes this rule, not an official estimate of Belg-dependent area.
